title: How the 2015–16 El Niño developed
description: Planned evidence-based reconstruction of the 2015–16 El Niño, including the stalled 2014 event and the North Pacific Blob.
status_note: Planned: work starts after the 1997–98 paper.

sections.title: Planned scope
sections.html:
This paper will follow the same framework as Paper 1: preconditions, triggers, amplifiers, suppressors, feedbacks and consequences, each graded A–D on event-specific evidence, with a timeline, an evidence table and verified references. RONI is the primary index.

Questions specific to this event:

  • Why the 2014 event stalled and how that preconditioned 2015.
  • The role of the 2014–16 North Pacific marine heatwave (the Blob) and the positive PDO.
  • Why the traditional ONI ranks it highest (+2.59) but RONI does not (+2.25): how much of the anomaly was tropical-wide warmth.
  • A central-Pacific-weighted peak and Southern California's dry winter despite the strong event.
